repeated ornamental motifs bordering/filling the field
justification: Both surfaces carry relief carving that includes a human figure and repeated decorative motifs, but that is about as generic as shared content gets. A shows a tall vertical monument with a frontal, elaborately costumed figure and dense columns of block-like glyph cartouches wrapping the shaft, while B shows a horizontal narrative frieze of a profile two-humped animal led by a striding profile attendant between rosette borders — different subjects, orientation, and rendering conventions.
